content.text:
I submitted **index 23 (Co 0.23 / Sb 0.77)**, which had the highest measured EQE at **0.034%**. All three merit measurements are spent. The absolute EQE is very low everywhere I measured, so no measured sample showed strong photoactivity.

| Index | Co fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | 0.68 | −0.0034 |
| 20 | 0.33 | 0.0063 |
| 23 | 0.23 | 0.034 |

- **Trend:** EQE rose as the Sb fraction increased. I spent the last measurement on index 23 because the Gaussian-process suggestion tool ranked it first.
- **XRD:** I used 3 of the 5 XRD scans. Index 20 (Co 0.33) and index 25 (Co 0.19) have nearly the same peaks. That fits the known CoSb₂O₆ phase at Co 1/3, but I didn't run the tool that compares them to simulated patterns, so the phase ID is unconfirmed. Index 14 (Co 0.51) has extra low-angle peaks, suggesting a mix of phases.
- **Not measured:** the most Sb-rich compositions (indices 24–27) and most of the Co-rich half. With the rising trend, a sample past index 23 could score higher, but there was no budget left to check.
